title: Next Stop, Socks
tagline: Set the switches. The socks have places to be.
concept: Route a wind-up model train through a tabletop rail yard and deliver odd parcels to stations with matching pictures.
core_loop: Check the picture on the next parcel, flip one or more track switches, then send the train and watch the route play out; each quick delivery feels like solving a small moving puzzle.
mechanics: Tap or click a switch to flip it, then tap the train or press Space to send it; arrow keys select switches and Enter flips them.; Deliver every parcel to clear the board; a wrong station or buffer hit punches one of three visible tickets, and losing all three ends the run.; Each delivery scores a point, and several correct routes in a row build a visible clean-run bonus.
feedback: Connected rails glow from the train before it moves. A correct delivery rings a bright bell, lights the station, and drops the parcel onto the platform. A wrong route ends with a dull clunk, a red flash, and a ticket being punched. If one switch is stopping an otherwise good route, the glow ends there, the lever shakes, and a soft click warns the player before they send the train.
difficulty: The first boards have one parcel, one switch, and short tracks. Later boards add more stations, crossing loops, several switches, and a visible stack of parcels that must be delivered in order, with no timer forcing the choice.
